subject: Private deployment: VPC license packaging and support banding proposal

Date: 2027-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood VPC term sheet and support band options

Hi Anna,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday — appreciate the clarity on Atlas Health's deployment constraints (PHI handling, regional failover, and on-call escalation windows). Attached is an updated term sheet (Redwood_VPC_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf) and a starter SOW (Atlas_SOW_draft.docx) with two packaging options:

- Option A (Core): single-region VPC, standard platform fee amortized over 36 months, Standard Support (business hours, 4hr P1 response SLA).
- Option B (Gold): active-active regional failover, platform fee amortized over 24 months, Premium Support (24/7 on-call, 1hr P1 response, weekly operational reviews).

Notes:
- I called out a separate line for the one-time deployment engineering retainer to cover air-gapped onboarding and HSM/KMS integration.
- We've left a placeholder for the platform fee amortization (we can show alternate amortization schedules if that helps procurement).

Would you be able to confirm which support band aligns with Atlas' procurement expectations? If you want us to show a blended pricing schedule (e.g., 30 months) I can run numbers with finance.

Next step: if the two options look directionally right, I'd like to propose a joint internal call with your procurement team and our commercial ops to line up licensing language and any audit clause changes.

Best,
Irene

2) Support tiers: what exactly is included in the weekly operational review for Premium Support (is there an escalation rota and named on-call engineers?), and do SLA credits apply for P1 incidents?
3) Deployment retainer: can that be applied as a credit against the first 6 months of platform fees instead of being billed upfront?

Also note: we need a specific clause outlining data-handling responsibilities with KMS — that will go to our legal.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call early next week with procurement and legal? Jake will coordinate timing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Anna — thanks, great questions. I've included Vanessa (Head of Commercial Pricing) and Mateo (Solutions Lead) so we can put numbers and the support roster behind the answers. See answers inline below and attached a short amortization table snapshot in the Drive link: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0B_Atlas_SOW

1) Platform fee amortization:
- 24-mo: $X/month (higher monthly but lower total interest-like allocation)
- 30-mo: $Y/month
- 36-mo: $Z/month
(We'll supply the exact dollar figures on the call — finance wants to run final cashflow impacts but these are directionally accurate.)

2) Premium Support scope:
- Weekly operational review = 30–45 minute cadence with named support manager and rotating on-call engineer; proactive health checks and token-level cost/latency trends.
- P1 SLA credits: yes, we apply service credits up to a capped percentage per incident; full language in SOW.

3) Deployment retainer: we can propose applying the retainer as a credit against the first 3 months of platform fees as a middle ground. For larger engineering scope (air-gapped/HSM) we can split the retainer 50/50 bill/install.

Anna — would you prefer the retainer credit applied to months 1–3 or amortized across the first 6 months on your P&L? I'll bring both numbers.

Internal: Vanessa, Mateo — please review and prepare:
- Vanessa: a short amortization table (24/30/36) with monthly and cumulative impact and suggested commercial levers (starter credit, annual commit discount).
- Mateo: proposed on-call roster language and SOW paragraph for P1 credits + KMS responsibilities.

We'll aim to have updated numbers before the procurement call Jake will schedule.

Thanks — Irene

Irene / Mateo — quick pricing proposal to present on the call:

Summary (aimed at CFO / procurement):
- Recommended packaging: Gold (Premium Support) with 30-month amortization for platform fee — balances monthly cashflow and long-term TCO.
- Concessions we can offer today without escalations: 7.5% one-time first-year discount on recurring (platform fees) if Atlas signs a 36-month commit AND accepts a 50% deployment retainer credit applied over first 3 months.
- Alternative (preferred commercial): 5% recurring discount + 1 month free (prorated) if Atlas takes our 24-month Premium Support and commits to a minimum monthly usage floor.

Line items to show on the procurement slide:
- Platform fee (monthly, amortized) — show 24/30/36 columns.
- Deployment retainer (bill/credit options).
- Support band delta (Standard vs Premium) with SLOs and credit caps.
- Optional add-on: Extended Retention (90 days) for additional fixed fee.

SOW/legal: Mateo please add the KMS handling paragraph: vendor responsibilities for key rotation, customer-managed keys in KMS, and logs to meet our SOC2 controls. Also include the SLA credit cap language Vanessa referenced.

Anna / Jake — if that direction works, we can prepare a single-slide commercial summary with the amortization table and two explicit concession paths for procurement to choose. Will that be helpful for your CFO?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
